title: Historic landmark tops spooky list as Essex named UK's most haunted
excerpt: Essex has been named the most haunted county across the UK, with Colchester Castle topping the list of spookiest spots.
content:
Essex has been named the most haunted county in the UK.

With 422 recorded ghost sightings, it tops the list outside of London, according to travel specialists Ski Vertigo, who analysed data from the Paranormal Database.

Colchester has the most of any place across the county with 30, followed by Clacton with 15 and Brentwood and Southend-on-Sea with 13 each.

Colchester Castle is said to be haunted by James Parnell, a Quaker who died there in the 1650s, and by a headless nun whose identity remains unknown.

Alex Dyer, managing director at Ski Vertigo, said: "Halloween falls at the end of half-term this year, so a lot of families will be after a day out with a good story behind it.

Colchester Castle (Image: NQ)

"Plenty of these ghosts belong to castles, abbeys, and old pubs you can actually visit, which makes them an easy trip with older children.

"Evening ghost tours can book up quickly in October, so it’s worth reserving early, and with the clocks going back on Sunday 25 October it will be dark an hour earlier that week."

London was excluded from the rankings as the database lists the capital by postcode area rather than as a county.

However, if counted as a whole, London would top the list with 810 reports.

Following Essex, Sussex ranked second with 404 ghost sightings, while Kent came third with 374.

Suffolk placed fourth with 350 reports, and Devon rounded out the top five with 340.

The top 10 most haunted counties in the UK, according to the Paranormal Database, are: Essex (422), Sussex (404), Kent (374), Suffolk (350), Devon (340), Dorset (323), Somerset and Bristol (320), Lancashire (307), Wiltshire (302), and Norfolk (293).

Each county’s total is paired with a well-known haunted location, such as Preston Manor in Sussex, Pluckley in Kent, and Framlingham Castle in Suffolk.

The rankings only include ghosts and hauntings, excluding reports of UFOs, big cats, and other paranormal phenomena.
